title: A Universal Quasi-Polish Space
summary: In this paper, we first construct a universal quasi-Polish space Y with the property that every quasi-Polish space is homeomorphic to a closed subspace of Y. This gives a hyperspace F(Y) of all quasi-Polish spaces which is itself a quasi-Polish space. We then prove that the collection of all Polish closed subspaces of Y forms a coanalytic, non-Borel subset of F(Y). In particular, this collection is Π11-complete.
